parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH=8 delivered val_bpb 0.998388. Depth scaling is clearly working. Since I previously thought a lower LR was needed for stability at depth 8, I'll now try reducing MATRIX_LR further to 0.05 to see if we can stabilize this massive gain and squeeze more performance.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.05 at DEPTH 8 to stabilize the high-capacity model and further reduce val_bpb.
